correctness.rationale: The 16-state trace is a bijection with all cyclic binary solutions to the exact open-neighborhood condition for n>=5. The gap lower bound n<=2k+3floor(k/2) and its constructive attainment prove every minimum degree; equality and defect counting yield the four stated coefficient classes. In the 7q+1 class the two short-defects at the unique short-short junction are the sole local overloads. A separate C++ subset enumerator for n=5..21 and Python transfer coefficient checks for n=5..80 reproduced every claimed condition. The finite checks are only consistency tests, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural all-cardinality enumerator for bounded-load total domination on quartic circulants is useful for load-limited placement, and the exact scale-invariant 2n loss at residue 1 captures a nontrivial distinction from ordinary total domination that is invisible in its known minimum and reconfiguration results. This structural local-obstruction theorem is not merely a re-labelled known total-domination count.
